subject: PixelEvents: Guestflow consent verification & CRM field mapping
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@pixelevents.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Guestflow + CRM sync for PixelEvents workshop

Hi Sean —

Thanks again for supporting our sponsor workshop at PixelCon next month. Quick details and asks so we can close the integration:

- We will be using the venue badge scanners (hands-free Kiosk A) and a contingency QR webform.
- Venue requests a visible one-line opt-in on any kiosk screen and retained consent in our records.
- Primary sync target is HubSpot (we also need a CSV export for one sponsor, Acme).
- Goal: dedupe by email + badge_id, include utm_source, company, title, and a short notes field.

Can Redwood:
1) Provide recommended kiosk opt-in text (short, legal-light) we can put on the scanner UI?
2) Share a mapping template for HubSpot fields + any offline handshake/ack requirements for the scanner vendor?
3) Confirm data retention / TTL options for offline records before they ship to HubSpot?

Attaching the venue's scanner spec (venue_scanner_spec_v1.pdf). Happy to hop on a 20m call if helpful.

Thanks —
Emma Li
Event Producer, PixelEvents
Attachments: venue_scanner_spec_v1.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@pixelevents.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Guestflow + CRM sync for PixelEvents workshop

Emma —

Thanks for the clear rundown. Short answers up front and a proposed next step:

1) Opt-in text (one-line): "I agree to be contacted by PixelEvents and sponsoring partners about conference-related updates and offers." — keeps it brief and covers sponsors. If you need EU language we can add a data controller line.

2) HubSpot mapping: I attach a one-page suggested field map (I also included a CSV template for the scanner vendor). Key fields we recommend: email, first_name, last_name, company, job_title, badge_id, utm_source, lead_source_detail, notes. For sponsors that want Acme-style exports we can also produce a scheduled CSV export that includes badge_id and email for dedupe.

3) Retention/TTL: By default Redwood can hold offline capture for up to 30 days before automatic flush to HubSpot; we can shorten to 7 days on request. We also support a manual flush API if you want to push earlier on demand. Ben — can you confirm the retention matrix options and add anything about encrypted-at-rest policy?

Proposed next step: Lauren and Ben, can you review the attached consent line (guestflow_consent_one-liner.docx) and the scanner config template (scanner_config_v3.csv) and confirm mapping and any required vendor handshake fields (checksum/session_id/etc.)? Emma — once internal is aligned we'll provide an implementation checklist and a short runbook for on-site staff.

Best,
Sean
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: guestflow_consent_one-liner.docx, scanner_config_v3.csv

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma@pixelevents.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:33:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Guestflow + CRM sync for PixelEvents workshop

All — quick mapping and ops notes from HubSpot/field side: 

- HubSpot required fields: email (primary), hs_lead_status (we'll default to "new"), lead_source (PixelCon), lifecycle_stage. Optional: utm_source, utm_campaign, badge_id (custom property).
- For offline scanner sync we need: a unique batch_id, batch_timestamp, record_sequence within batch, and an md5 checksum on the CSV file name for vendor ACKs. Add a session_id field if the scanner vendor emits it.
- Dedupe rules: run dedupe by email first, then badge_id — record merges should append notes with source=badge_scan and preserve original created_at.
- Consent handling: store the one-line consent text in a custom property "consent_text" and a boolean "consent_given" with timestamped "consent_date". That lets legal audit easily.

Next actions:
1) Sean — confirm opt-in language and we will sign off on the HubSpot property list.
2) Ben — Ben, please confirm retention/enc-at-rest and whether 30 days default is ok for PixelEvents; also flag if we need to redact IPs for this vendor.
3) Emma — please confirm if Acme needs a separate CSV schema or they can accept the same fields with a different header order.

I'll add the HubSpot property creation ticket to our backlog once Sean confirms.

Cheers,
Lauren
Field Marketing Ops

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma@pixelevents.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Guestflow + CRM sync for PixelEvents workshop

Thanks — confirming retention and security posture: 

- Retention options: 7 days / 14 days / 30 days (default) — all stored encrypted at rest with HSM-managed keys. For PixelEvents we recommend 14 days to balance sponsor requests and auditability.
- Redaction: we can support automatic IP redaction on export; recommend enabling for public Wi-Fi venues.
- Export ACK: we will send an ACK file with md5 checksum and batch_id; vendor should respond with ACK receipt event.

Attaching the retention matrix (retention_matrix.xlsx).

If that works Emma, please reply with either: (a) "Approve 14-day retention + HubSpot mapping" or (b) ask for a 7-day TTL. We will then open the HubSpot property ticket and schedule the vendor handoff call.

Short sign-off from Acme rep Theo (cc'd) would also help avoid last-minute CSV tweaks.

Best,
Ben
Director, Data Ops
Attachments: retention_matrix.xlsx
